behavior-tests.source: health.py direct-object handler for GOB 326 restores full HP and IS after resurrection; retail 81 88 carries the ability and answer.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityResurrection.Reply validates the pending authenticated offer, then RestoreVitals and Present update the recipient and observer.
behavior-tests.test: ability-resurrection-resources casts Revitalize RSI on a dead player over the regular command path, asserts no restoration before consent, matches the offer and motion, verifies recipient and observer resource records, and rejects repeat Yes. ability-resurrection-approval-guards checks refusal, timeout and stale approval separately.
